issue.title: test_new_project_bare_git_create_and_review_hide_visibility_png_snapshots times out on create check
issue.description:
Discovered independently by the lander for sase-1kx.5.3.3 while reviewing publication phase sase-1kx.5.3.3.2 note #2. Both observed CI runs used be73b6021ac29d8fcad2cb897192bc6455a47e2b, with no source change between fail and pass. The epic changes nine other visual fixture files, not this node or its implementation.

Full CI 38683274240, visual job 116275103654 timed out after 15s waiting for create check settled. The SVG shows Bare git loading cached candidates, no owners available, and Checking name availability. Same-SHA Full CI 38698824253 visual job 116305071749 passed this node (its only failures were single_main_paged and Tool Runs cards; 1364 passed).

Observed pair: 1 failure / 1 pass in full parallel CI. No isolated serial reproduction is claimed. Root cause unproven, so size large is intentional.

Identify why seeded provider/check state remains in flight under the full visual lane. Preserve the bare-git visibility assertions and existing timeout; fix the proven fixture isolation, scheduling, or product defect and demonstrate stable capture without rebaselining a loading state.
